title: Yao-Yao Graph a Spanner?
exact_target: For which fixed cone counts $k$ is the Yao--Yao graph $YY_k$ a $t$-spanner with a constant $t$ independent of the finite point set? This records the source\textquotesingle s question for the family $YY_k$, allowing the constant to depend on $k$.
